reviews_captured_by_me.text: Ryan did an exceptional job building the cupboards for our walk-in pantry. He was responsive, easy to work with, and paid close attention to the small custom details I wanted. He even came up with a clever way to customize one cabinet so our large stainless-steel pot fits perfectly without changing the cabinet’s overall size. His craftsmanship and problem-solving were impressive. We’re extremely happy with the result and would highly recommend him.

I have a Hayes Town house and was anxious about the quality of the cabinets I wanted to add to the home and modifications to the existing cabinetry. Ryan did a great job of blending the styles and meeting the quality standards I expected. He is very conscientious about his work and his goal is to please his client. In addition to the  cabinets I had him build a new island that looks like the custom piece I hoped it would be. He gave my existing cabinets a much needed tuneup by adjusting drawers and adding pull outs. I highly recommend him.
Ryan with Empire Cabinets did an excellent job building out my cabinets for my island enlargement & also painting them.  Expert craftsmanship & attention to detail!  Highly recommend!
